Who we are  

Fruitico is a dynamic and fast growing business with farms across Australia. We have three table grape farms in Western Australia, located in Hamel, Meelon and Broome. We are looking for horticulture and farm workers to join us for our upcoming pre-harvest and harvest seasons.  

About the role  

We are seeking self motivated and physically fit candidates to fill a total of 300 part-time farm positions we have available from October 2026 to October 2027. The roles will be working across all three of our locations, in Hamel, Meelon and Broome.  

We require people to prepare vines for harvest, pick table grapes and perform other general farm maintenance (including cleaning). Some responsibilities of include but are not limited to:  

• Preparing vines for harvest  

• Picking table grapes  

• General farm maintenance  

• Leaf plucking 

 • Planting  

• Bunch work  

• Pruning  

• Working in a packing shed  

You will be required to work 30 hours per week and work commences between 05:30-07:00am with finishing times varying throughout the season depending on operational requirements, with some days work ceasing when the sun goes down. Our farms operate 7 days a week during harvest so you may be required to work throughout the week, including weekends (subject to rest days off). All work is performed outdoors.  

Remuneration 

Hourly rates start at $26.44 per hour. There are Horticulture Grades 2-3 pay rates available depending on skill as paid under the Horticulture Award 2020. 

About you  

You must:  

• Be ready and available to work throughout the entire period  

• Be physically fit and able to pass a pre-employment medical  

• Be willing and able to work weekends and overtime as required  

• Show initiative and a strong motivation to work 

• Be able to follow instructions in relation to job tasks and hygiene  

• Be willing to work outdoors
